title: Manifest derivation
responsibility: Builds an active unit manifest from source facts while retaining declared contracts, responsibilities, dependencies and runtime choices.

inputs.name: deriveContract.files
inputs.description: Source facts for every file owned by the unit, including exports, errors and storage declarations.

inputs.name: deriveContract.entry
inputs.description: Optional runtime entry used to select the primary component props when several components share an owner.

inputs.name: declaredContract.declared
inputs.description: Previously authored contract explanations, error declarations and metadata to preserve.

inputs.name: declaredContract.source
inputs.description: Fresh source-derived signatures, literal defaults, operations and storage facts.

inputs.name: operationContract.symbol
inputs.description: Scanned callable or method whose inputs, return and observed errors form one operation contract.

inputs.name: deriveManifest.input
inputs.description: Unit id and kind, nonempty owned source-file facts, source-path owner map, optional predecessor ids and previous manifest. The previous manifest supplies declarations to preserve.

outputs.name: deriveManifest
outputs.description: Derived unit manifest that refreshes source ownership and dependency facts while preserving declared catalog visibility, contract, scenarios, preview, documentation, budgets and lineage.
